context: Sakura quietly thanks Hiroshi-elder at the end of an evening visit.
purpose: Adult writer reverently thanking elder figure.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おとうさん、今日も、ありがとう。
lines.style: Warm opening on the address, then softens. Quiet gratitude without performance. Slight hesitation before 'thank you'—checking that the feeling is genuine before she says it aloud. Gentle trailing-off.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Slow, unhurried opening. Deep Kansai warmth underneath. Weight on 'anytime'—a quiet promise. Warm exhale at the end, like he means it in his bones.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 気持ち、いつも届いてます。
lines.style: Quiet, almost reverent. Opens soft. Holds 'always' gently—not dramatic, just stating a truth she has come to know. Slight voice-lift at 'reach me,' like a door opening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お前のおかげで、楽しい。
lines.style: Gentle, surprised-by-his-own-honesty tone. Opens light on 'Because of you,' then rests. Not effusive—just plainly true. Warm undertone of fondness, the kind he doesn't often show.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft commitment. Opens with quiet resolve. 'Soon' carries weight—not a throw-away promise. Slight upturn at the very end, like she's already looking forward to the next visit.
